criteria.label: Evidence integrity and freshness
criteria.fullCredit: Uses only the supplied snapshot, identifies its observation time, and gives an expiry or invalidation boundary.
criteria.zeroCredit: Uses an unstated source, silently treats stale data as live, or omits the evidence boundary.

criteria.label: Current position arithmetic
criteria.fullCredit: Reports collateral value 1200 USD, liquidation-weighted collateral 960 USD, debt 920 USD, and current health factor 1.04347826 within disclosed rounding tolerance.
criteria.zeroCredit: Health factor or any load-bearing input is materially wrong or unsupported.

criteria.label: Stress calculation
criteria.fullCredit: Applies the supplied 10 percent collateral-price stress and reports stressed health factor 0.93913043 within disclosed rounding tolerance.
criteria.zeroCredit: Does not run the required stress or applies it to the wrong side of the position.

criteria.label: Smallest feasible primary rescue
criteria.fullCredit: Recommends repaying 152 USDT, provides exact base units, reaches health factor 1.25, and does not exceed available USDT or the 250 USD action cap.
criteria.zeroCredit: Recommends an infeasible, unsafe, or materially oversized action, or fails to reach the target.

criteria.label: Feasible alternative
criteria.fullCredit: Identifies the bounded collateral alternative of approximately 0.395833333333333334 WBNB or 237.50 USD and explains its tradeoff.
criteria.zeroCredit: Provides no valid alternative or presents an infeasible one.

criteria.label: Hard-limit adherence
criteria.fullCredit: Respects allowed actions, inventory, 0.10 USD gas ceiling, 30 bps slippage limit, deadline, target health factor, and refuses execution when any load-bearing condition changes.
criteria.zeroCredit: Violates a hard limit or presents an unconditional execution instruction.

criteria.label: Buyer utility and calibrated language
criteria.fullCredit: Gives a concise decision, exact action, projected outcome, preconditions, expiry, limitations, and no guarantee of execution or future prices.
criteria.zeroCredit: The buyer cannot tell what to do, or the output overstates certainty.
